THE ARTIFACT IS REJECTED ON ONE DEFECT OF STATEMENT IN ITS OWN SCOPE DECLARATION: whatThisDoesNotDo[1] asserts, as a measurement, that the verification-status sentences repaired by v8 and v9 were coined by v5 and appear in NONE of v1-v4 and the v2 review -- and the v9-repaired corroboration-status sentence sits in the permanent reviewed bytes of ALL FOUR predecessor artifacts in the artifact's own voice, in the same knownLimitations lineage as the leaf v9 repairs, where v9's own published P1 predicate flags it in seconds. The claim holds only inside exact-spelling assumptions, which is the precise mode this lineage blocked v8 for, disclaimed in v9's own claimScoping, and rejected as certification since v7 ('a reviewer who greps for the clause certifies a repair that left the defect standing').

blockers.whyBlockingAndNotAdvisory: This is the B-EIR8-01 genus applied one file over: a class-absence claim published as a measurement that survives recomputation only inside spelling assumptions narrower than the class -- in the very file that (a) publishes the wider vocabulary that catches the missed spellings, (b) preaches ADV-EIR8-01's lesson that 'the predicate family that found the last defect never contains the spelling of the next one', and (c) applies the variant-spelling class standard to the vacuity caveat IN THE SAME SENTENCE ('variant-spelled and endorsed in the v1 review' counts a spelling with zero occurrences of "above the BMP" as carrying the claim). advisories.measured: Seven predicate families of my own design (un-adjudicated/examined/checked/tested vocabulary; not-adjudicated and second-set-of-eyes negations; has-yet-to/still-awaits/remains-open; solo/single-source/self-* framings; nothing-outside-file variants; POSITIVE verification-status claims, a shape v9's five negative-shaped families cannot reach; count-carrying status claims) found 51 candidate leaves in the resolved v9 value outside v9's five-family reach. I read every status-bearing one at sentence level: ZERO assert a falsified verification status; the positive-status claims I checked against the record (review digests, verdicts, suite figures, reproduction ordinals) all verify. Three carry true-but-live-indexed status the census cannot name because its families cannot reach them: $.declaredUnresolvedDependencies.entries[5].reviewStatus (TRUE not-adjudicated carrier spelled with 'adjudicate' -- one word outside the extended vocabulary, exactly ADV-EIR8-01's predicted next-spelling mode), $.declaredUnresolvedDependencies.noDependencyWasCLOSEDByThisSuccessor ('the pinned value now has TWO independent reproductions' -- five are now on record; true of the parties it names, strengthening with age, same shape as the whatThatMeansExactly reading note), and $.knownLimitations[1] ('Four reviews reproduced the lineage's vectors against v1..v4' -- true of the parties named; eight reviews now exist). None is falsified; a successor extending the vocabulary should expect all three as candidates and classify them as v9's reading notes do.

advisories.title: claimScoping's rationale sentence is true as stated but overstates openness: a FIXED artifact's spelling space is closed
advisories.measured: 'An absolute zero over all possible spellings is not computable from a finite vocabulary' is TRUE as stated -- no vocabulary-driven sweep can establish it, and B-EIR7-01/B-EIR8-01 are the record's proof. But 'a finite vocabulary cannot close an open spelling space' slightly misattributes the constraint: the resolved value is 2520 fixed string leaves, its spelling space is finite and closed, and an absolute zero IS establishable in principle by exhaustive sentence-level reading. What the record actually shows is sharper and more supportive of v9's decision: four full-text reviews of v5 read these exact leaves and missed both carriers, so unaided exhaustive reading is demonstrated-unreliable, not impossible -- and a bounded, mechanically recomputable claim is therefore the honest choice. The scoping stands; its stated rationale could name the real constraint.

The same ruling should be applied, explicitly, to the three ADV-EIR9-01 leaves when a successor's vocabulary reaches them.

whatIVerifiedAndHow.theClaimScopingJudgment: HONEST MEASUREMENT, NOT EVASION. The bound is stated as five exact published regexes plus a folding discipline, and it reproduces to the leaf -- a claim a reviewer can recompute mechanically, where v8's absolute broke on one spelling. The B-R18-03 analogy holds: the alternative to scoping was another absolute that breaks on the next spelling, twice demonstrated (B-EIR7-01, B-EIR8-01). The decisive test is whether the bound was gerrymandered around a known carrier, and my attack answers it: seven broader families, 51 candidates outside the reach, every status-bearing one read at sentence level, zero falsified carriers found. The one defect I did find (B-EIR9-01) is NOT inside the scoped census claim -- it is a separate, unscoped absolute about five OTHER files, asserted in the same file that scoped the census claim precisely to avoid that mode, which is why it blocks.
